
DESCRIPTION
Manage environment variables

USAGE
  one env [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  bind           选择共享凭据的存放项目和默认环境
  get            Read an environment variable
  list           List environment-variable names
  pull           Pull remote environment variables
  set            Set an environment variable
  switch         Switch the environment-variable source
  unset          删除一个 Infisical 环境变量

EXAMPLES
  one env
  one env set DATABASE_URL
  one env list

TIPS
Shows the environment-variable source and scope, or safely sets, reads, and lists variables. list shows names only.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --env <value>            环境名
  --global                 管理 Infisical 共享凭据，可在工作区之外使用
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --path <value>           共享凭据目录（仅当前层，不递归）
